history.reason: DataAnalysis.tsx: exported runOLS/getResetThreshold/getZThreshold/median/RawReading/CorrectionRow so the regression-correction workflow could be unit tested (see DataAnalysis.test.ts). +4 react-refresh/only-export-components warnings, same accepted trade-off already present in Compliance.tsx for the same reason.

Moved runOLS and friends out of DataAnalysis.tsx into lib/regressionCorrection.ts (a plain .ts file, no JSX). react-refresh/only-export-components only fires on files exporting React components, so the 4 warnings from the previous entry disappeared entirely rather than needing to be carried indefinitely -- the extraction is a strictly better fix than accepting the trade-off in place.

ProductSection.tsx: wired ProductMeterHistoryDialog to the shared CorrectionReasonField/logReadingEdit pattern -- product meter edits were the one reading-edit surface missing a required correction reason and an audit-log entry (well/locator/power/blending/RO train/pretreatment/CIP/dosing already had both). DataCorrections.tsx: fetchPending() now joins reading_anomaly_remarks per pending row so the operator's own entry-time remark shows on each Pending Review card. +7 no-explicit-any warnings from the new supabase `.from(... as any)` calls and logReadingEdit payloads, same convention already used throughout these files.

Reconciling drift accumulated across the weekly-granularity work (M1-M4 of pwri-improvement-plan.md) plus this pass's own changes -- CI has been red since before this pass started. Two parts: (1) buildEntityPivot-fix-rebased.patch, ro_pretreat_delete_rls_fix.sql, and reconciled-weekly-granularity.patch (the three commits after this file's previous 1627 entry) were never accompanied by a ceiling update -- actual was already 1635 as of the commit this file still claimed 1627 for, rising to 1640 by the most recent of the three. Not re-litigated here; treated as inherited baseline. (2) This pass's own net +1: TrendChartDrill.tsx was split into TrendChartDrill.tsx (GranularityControl/StackToggle/DrillBreadcrumb components only) and TrendChartDrillKit.ts (stack-mode persistence, drill-focus math, toggleIsolateEntity, makeDrillableBarShape -- plain .ts, no JSX, same fix already used once for lib/regressionCorrection.ts) which removed 7 react-refresh/only-export-components warnings; Raw Water's By-well breakdown and Plant Health's Day-to-Hour click-drill (extending M2/M3/M4 per the plan) added 8 no-explicit-any warnings from Recharts payload/row callbacks, the same convention already used throughout TrendChart.tsx (see e.g. the entity-breakdown Tooltip formatter and dot renderer this mirrors). TDS/Recovery's by-train view is the one chart from the plan still on daily-only lines with no Weekly/Monthly/stacking/drill -- left for a follow-up pass rather than rushed in here.

Inherited drift, not re-litigated (same situation as the entry above): hamas-production-fix.patch (55e95f8) added a directMeterIds set to DataSummaryModal.tsx/TrendChart.tsx/TrendChartDataSummaryPopup.tsx/Dashboard.tsx -- the same 'is_derived meter as direct-volume' fix that had also been prepared independently on this end -- but its own +16 no-explicit-any warnings (from the new supabase `.from(product_meters as any)` filter/map callbacks building that set, same convention already used for directLocatorIds) were never folded into this file. pwri-dashboard-fixes.patch, sibling-locators-stacked-chart.patch, and hamas-mambaling-same-day-sweep.patch (the three commits after it) added none of their own. This pass's own change -- EntityHistoryChart.tsx: replaced the SIBLING_PALETTE slot that collided with the mother meter's own green (C_PRODUCTION, hue 142) with a rose hue (330) so a sibling locator can no longer render in the same color as the 'Mother Meter' bar/legend entry it sits next to -- added zero new warnings on its own.

Fixing a regression, not adding one -- net -6. trendchart-weekly-granularity-1.patch (4e3c952) was applied from what looks like a branch that forked before the 1641 entry above landed: it overwrote TrendChartDrill.tsx back to its pre-split, monolithic form (byte-identical to the commit before that split), silently orphaning TrendChartDrillKit.ts (0 importers afterward) and bringing back the 7 react-refresh/only-export-components warnings that split had removed -- the 1657 entry above inherited this without diagnosing it. Re-split TrendChartDrill.tsx (GranularityControl/StackToggle/DrillBreadcrumb only) from TrendChartDrillKit.ts (everything else) again, -7. Also restored Plant Health's Day-to-Hour click-drill (phDayFocus/phFocusedHourlyData/handlePhDayDotActivate), which the same stale-branch overwrite had dropped entirely -- +1 no-explicit-any from phFocusedHourlyData's row-shaped filter callback, same convention as everywhere else in this file. Also fixed a real bug introduced in the same reorganization (zero warning impact): TDS/Recovery's by-train Legend onClick was wired to handleLegendIsolate, which only updates selectedLocatorIds -- irrelevant to by-train, whose visibility depends on selectedTrainIds -- so clicking a train's legend entry silently did nothing. Added handleTrainLegendIsolate (mirrors handleWellLegendIsolate) and pointed both by-train Legends at it.

Guizo train-permeate wiring (20260813_secondary_ro_train_wiring.sql: ro_trains.unit_type/feed_source_train_id/reject_routing, for Potable-RO/Refilling-RO as secondary 2nd-pass units whose reject recirculates into Train 1's permeate). PlantTopology.tsx/PretreatmentAndROLog.tsx (secondary_ro_train_wiring.patch, fca157c) added the new columns to existing supabase selects and an isSecondaryTrain/(train as any) check -- same any-row convention already used throughout both files, +9. This pass's own change, the double-count guard for the two headline production numbers: a secondary unit's permeate is the same water its upstream primary train already counted once, so it must never be summed again into Production/NRW%. Dashboard.tsx: _permeateTrainMeta's ro_trains select and _qualityTrainMeta's metaMap now carry unit_type, threaded into the permeate-production sum and its no-product-meter fallback (+8). TrendChart.tsx: _roTrainMeta now also builds a trainUnitTypeMap (kept separate from the existing trainPlantMap, which several unrelated call sites still expect as Map<string,string>), consumed by the primary and fallback permeate-accumulation loops and by the by-train drill-down pivot/legend so a secondary unit can't appear as a second stacked production source next to its own upstream train (+5). Deliberately did not touch _roTrainIdsForReadings/_qualityTrainIds themselves in either file -- those still include secondary units, because their own RO readings/TDS/recovery/Plant Health are legitimate and should keep showing up elsewhere on both pages; only the specific volume-summing sites were guarded.
